references.text: Moses presents the same choice between blessing and curse, life and death, and urges the people to choose life by loving the Lord.
A detailed description of the blessings that follow obedience to the Lord's commands, expanding on the concept of 'blessing' mentioned in 11:26.
A detailed description of the curses that follow disobedience, expanding on the concept of 'curse' mentioned in 11:26.
Joshua sets before the people a similar choice about whom they will serve, continuing the theme of choosing between blessing and curse.
Elijah challenges the people to choose between the Lord and Baal, applying the same principle of choosing between blessing and curse.
The Lord lays out the way of life and the way of death for the people, reflecting the choice between blessing and curse.
Jesus speaks about the narrow and the wide road, representing the choice between life and destruction, parallel to blessing and curse.
Paul discusses the curse of the law and Christ as the one who frees from this curse, connecting to the theme of blessing and curse.
